title: Q-SHIP-adapter: the unfinished Cloudflare adapter entry is finished and shipped
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** SHIP-PLAN-1: workers/adapters/cloudflare/src/worker.js and its test were cut off mid-build; two of its tests fail (US-03-R06, US-03-R01)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation shipplan --check
**Status:** open

Restore the held files from ultrastable/ops wip/session-2026-11-26/held/, make the `/health` and tick-row tests pass against the current tick (steps counted from the composed modules), and ship it as one bounded slice.

**Prediction:** shipplan.remaining_landed >= 3 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** deleting any unmerged work (it is stored in ultrastable/ops under wip/); a change over 60 files or 3,000 lines (SMALL-CHANGE-1); specification text on a public branch (DISCLOSE-1).

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation shipplan --check` exits 0 on main. It exits 1 while any entry of doctrine/ship-plan.json has not landed.
